title: Why every autonomous AI agent needs its own computer and a spending limit
description: Autonomous agents need persistent storage, dedicated compute, and hard budget guardrails. Here is how we built VM Nebula for 1-click production deployment.
heroAlt: VM Nebula dedicated cloud computer for AI agents with built-in spend controls.
html:
Running autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, Agent Zero, or n8n on a personal laptop breaks the moment you close the lid. Running them on raw cloud instances without spend guardrails risks runaway token and compute bills overnight.

A Dedicated Computer for Your AI Agent

At VM Nebula, we built the cloud platform we wished existed: 1-click dedicated cloud VMs pre-configured for modern AI agents, paired with persistent storage and strict, real-time spending limits.

Predictable Costs by Design

Every deployment includes clear usage visibility and configurable spending caps, allowing founders and engineering teams to run 24/7 assistants across WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, and internal workflows with complete confidence.
